## The trap

`apps/operator/package.json` lists `@tailwindcss/postcss` — so it looks like a
Tailwind app, and a shadcn-ecosystem registry component (Kibo UI, shadcn/ui
blocks, etc.) looks like a drop-in vendor. **It is not.** That dep sits in the
Storybook devDeps; there is no `tailwind.config.*`, no `postcss.config.*`, and
no `@import "tailwindcss"` anywhere in `apps/operator/app` or
`apps/operator-vite`. Tailwind utility classes in vendored code compile to
nothing — the component renders bare and unstyled, which reads as "the library
is broken" when it's really the build.

## The recipe (proven on the plan kanban, 2026-06-12)

Vendoring `shadcnblocks/kibo` `packages/kanban` into
`app/harness/Kanban.tsx` + `Kanban.css`:

1. **Keep the behavior source verbatim where possible** — dnd-kit wiring,
   a11y announcements, context/composition API. That's the value you're
   borrowing.
2. **Port every Tailwind class to a token-CSS class** in a co-located
   stylesheet (the `app/harness/*.css` convention). Map shadcn vars to ours:
   `bg-secondary` → `var(--bg-2)`, `Card`/`bg-card` → `var(--bg-raised)`,
   `ring-primary` → `box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent)`, `border` →
   `1px solid var(--border)`, muted text → `var(--fg-dim)`/`var(--fg-mute)`.
   Keep the upstream class string in a comment above each rule so the next
   upgrade can diff.
3. **Replace shadcn-only deps with primitives**: `<ScrollArea>` → native
   `overflow-y: auto`; `cn()` → a 3-line local `cx()`; `tunnel-rat` → an
   explicit render prop (the Kanban's `overlay` prop).
4. **Give the component a height constraint upstream assumed from its sized
   parent** — Kibo-style `size-full` components silently grow unbounded in a
   page-scrolled pane (the kanban's columns hit 2300px tall before a
   `max-height` cap was added).

Token catalog: `/internal/docs/design/tokens`. Decision matrix row for the
kanban itself: `/internal/docs/design`.

## Verifying visuals on the headless box (what §15.4 doesn't say)

- `tauri-agent-tools screenshot` platform-detects **Wayland from your shell
  env** and demands `sway`/`grim` even when your target instance is on an
  X11 Xvfb. Force it: `env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY XDG_SESSION_TYPE=x11
  DISPLAY=:NN tauri-agent-tools screenshot …` — and pass `--title Papercusp`.
- Even then the window matcher can pick a 10×10 helper window (or a zombie
  window from a killed instance — `xdotool windowkill` the leftovers).
  Fallback that always works: bridge-`eval` a red
  `el.style.outline='3px solid red'` on the element, `import -window <id>`,
  crop to the outline.
- The debug shell embeds VTE terminal panes beside the webview (the webview
  gets only part of the window). `PAPERCUSP_DEV_WRAPPER=0` does **not**
  remove the terminal panes; the control-bar pane switcher (PUI / DEV / …)
  picks which webview is visible.
